segments.title: November
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! November is Black Friday, plus Thank U, Next. This month starts with gratitude and ends with the best long-plan prices of the year. First we say thank you. Then we say, sincerely, have you seen this annual?

segments.title: ₹1.81L
segments.text: So, the number. Our November target for Pop-up is 1.81 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent above last November. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 3 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 99,700 rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 79,800, and everything else 1,800. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 48 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 562 leads, 146 trials, and 48 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 1.12 lakh rupees, which is 62 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Thank U, Next (Year)
segments.text: First up, Thank U, Next Year. Appreciation week. A guest pass to share, a members-only night, and a gift for anyone who's hit a hundred classes. No catch. Just gratitude, and glutes. The plan is 1 buyer at about 5,900, so 5,900 rupees.

segments.title: Pop-Up, Don't Drop Out
segments.text: Next, for pop-up trialists, Pop-Up, Don't Drop Out. Buy a pack within seventy-two hours of the trial for fifteen per cent off, fifteen extra days, and a class to bring a friend. The plan is 12 buyers at about 7,200, so 86,700 rupees.

segments.title: Secret Santa Squats
segments.text: Then, for gifting, Secret Santa Squats. Two classes and grip socks, sized for a Secret Santa budget. If the recipient loves it, half comes off their first month. The plan is 5 buyers at about 1,000, so 5,000 rupees.

segments.title: Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday
segments.text: And finally, the big one, Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday. Four days of the year's best long-plan prices, plus the last Club Nine seats. No one-month discounts. We're not that kind of studio. The plan is 2 buyers at about 7,200, so 14,500 rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, appreciation week, with guest passes and hundred-class gifts. Week two, Secret Santa vouchers reach every office and group chat. Week three, members get the Black Friday dates first. Week four, four days of Black Friday, long plans only.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's November at Pop-up. 1.81 lakh rupees, four offers, and 48 buyers to welcome. Grateful, gorgeous, and fully booked. That's November.
